content:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: multiple paged-attention worker pods reporting OOM / CUDA_IRQ errors across shard-us-west-2a. Auto-escalation triggered. Trace-id=trc-9f2a
oncall-bot: Symptoms: repeated container restarts, kernel logs show device-side assert and then oom_killer invoked on nn-infer process. Rolling 503s observed on some customers.
anya: I'm on it. seeing steady memory creep on paged allocator metrics — free slab count trending down, fragmentation ratio up. Looks like small unlinked slots accumulating, not immediate big leak.
prashant: Can you paste the latest node dmesg and allocator stack traces? I want to see the callsites for the leaked pages.
anya: dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.568012] oom_kill_process: ptrace 0x0 vs 0x0
[ 1234.568901] Killed process 31415 (nn-infer) total-vm:13500000kB, anon-rss:12000000kB
```

allocator stack from pod logs (truncated):
```
alloc_paged_slot(size=128) -> page_acquire_locked() -> kv_cache_attach() -> try_evict_prefix() -> mark_stale()
... repeated stamps with different slot ids ...
```

bryce: Repro on canary: run long prompt mix with streaming and interleave >70% chat reqs -> memory ramps slowly over hours. paging churn increases.
carmen: Customer impact: several Pro customers report degraded latency and occasional 503s since ~10:42 UTC. No large-scale data loss. CS queue picking up threads.
anya: Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable paging on affected pool (force in-memory mode) 2) bump eviction_aggressiveness to 3x 3) apply hotpatch to allocator to force periodic compaction (a short-lived guard) 4) if still failing, scale down model length_allowed and divert heavy tails to fallback smaller model.
prashant: I can push the eviction bump and compaction toggle. I'll coordinate restart sequence to avoid thundering herd. Need approval to touch prod config.
bryce: +1 from eng-runtime. we should also add a temporary 1m cooldown on KV attach to reduce allocation storm.
anya: I'll open a short-lived experiment flag: `paged.kv.compact_period=60s` and `paged.eviction.mult=3`. Doing a rolling restart on 3 nodes at a time.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: refs/heads/hotfix/paged-compact  -> prod/eng-runtime. CI checks passed. ETA apply in 2m. :rocket:
prashant: Applying config now on shard-us-west-2a (nodes 7-10). Logging target: /var/log/rl/infer/paged-compact.log

prashant: Command I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n infer set env deploy/nn-infer PAGED_COMPACT_PERIOD=60s PAGED_EVICT_MULT=3 --record
kubectl -n infer rollout restart deploy/nn-infer --field-selector metadata.name=nn-infer -l shard=us-west-2a --timeout=10m
```

anya: Observing metrics: within ~6 minutes, small drop in fragmentation ratio and incoming per-pod RSS slope reduced. No further OOM kills so far. Still under watch.
carmen: Noted — CS updated customers in impacted cohort with status note. No escalations to execs yet.
bryce: Next steps if we see recurrence: 1) force-disable paging entirely for the pool and route traffic to dedicated memory-heavy nodes 2) start customer-mitigation routing (fallback model) 3) longer-term revert: conservative allocator rewrite.
prashant: I'm going to leave a rolling note in the oncall doc and handoff at 11:30 UTC. If anything spikes, ping me @prashant.
anya: Leaving on-call handoff in 20m. Current state: mitigations applied, fragmentation trending down, customer 503s decreased by 80%. Will escalate to SRE postmortem if we see another breach.
customer-success: Thanks for the quick update — CS is letting impacted customers know engineering has applied a hotpatch and is monitoring. Customers asked for ETA on full fix; we said 24-48h.
prashant: tagging follow-ups: 1) collect heap profiles from affected hosts (heaptrack sampling) 2) run synthetic long-tail load for 6h to validate fix 3) create rollback plan for config toggles.
anya: i'll attach logs & flamegraphs to the incident doc. saving a copy of the hotfix commit: git+https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/fea7c9b (hotfix: paged compaction guard).
prashant: Handoff: next oncall @bryce at 11:30 UTC. Current severity: Sev-2. Impact: intermittent 503s for pro customers, latency degradation.
bryce: ack. I'll pick up monitoring dashboards and run the 6h synthetic. If anything reappears I'll escalate to oncall-sre. :eyes:
anya: Thanks team. keeping the thread open for final closure once 6h validation passes. :white_check_mark:
